_notes._strategy: Baseline seed captured 2026-05. Stories enumerate per-variant (Secondary, Destructive, etc.); demos consolidate (variants.tsx, sizes.tsx). The two surfaces are intentionally separate — see CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md. This allowlist captures the world as it stands so the lint only fires on NEW drift introduced after this date. Reviewers should challenge new entries during PR review and prefer authoring the missing variant on the other surface when sensible.

_common_patterns.perVariantStoriesVsConsolidatedDemo: stories Secondary/Destructive/Ghost/Outline → demo variants.tsx. Story-only by design. Badge: the per-tone stories (success, warning, info, error-tone) each show both appearances; demo status.tsx consolidates them, so it is demo-only. Badge demo destructive.tsx sets the earlier destructive look beside error soft and solid for the deprecation note; the Status Palette story checks the destructive name itself.
_common_patterns.perSizeStoriesVsSizesDemo: stories Small/Medium/Large → demo sizes.tsx. Story-only by design.
_common_patterns.singularStoryVsPluralDemo: story WithIcon → demo with-icons. Treat as conceptual match; allowlisted on story side.
_common_patterns.basicStoryVsDefaultDemo: story Basic → demo default. Conceptual match; allowlisted.
_common_patterns.interactionFixture: story exists only to host real-browser play() checks with no docs counterpart (countdown: block-layout, copy, labelled-layout, re-show, reduced-motion, suspense-reveal, tens-roll and width measure layout, copying, the roll, a reveal after a Suspense fallback and pending width in Chromium; animated and pending are prop views the docs describe in prose; rolling-number: copy, direction-and-wrap, interrupt, layout, part-order, re-show, reduced-motion and token-drives-roll measure the roll, copy, baseline and bidi order in Chromium; not-animated and trend-down are prop views the docs describe in prose; reel: one story per behaviour of the design, measuring real layout, scrolling, focus, pointer, wheel, reduced motion and painted pixels; filter-chips: tab-stop, arrow-keys, cancelled-change, outside-change, focused-chip-removed, focused-chip-disabled, ignored-arrow, row-changes, arrow-race, right-to-left, disabled-press, consumer-prevention, modified-arrow-focus, no-destination, reentrant-focus, repeated-keys, nested-rows, child-reorder, host-replaces-itself, empty-rows, removed-and-moved, recovery-rules and hidden-chips drive real keys, focus and pointer; hydration enters and hydrates server markup with real Tab; cost measures the row's observers on 100 chips; looks, heights, wrapping, motion, custom-render measure computed style; oversized-label and with-icons document layouts the docs leave to the app; motion-compared sets the built and the previous chip timing side by side for review by eye; pill-strengths sets the count pill's tint at three strengths side by side for review by eye; selected-pill-strengths does the same for the selected chip's pill; morphing pill (Tabs): Browser stories step Motion's frame loop to check morphing Tabs geometry and lifecycle; badge: status-as-link hovers each linked status Badge with the real pointer in both appearances at both sizes and checks the underline is painted inside the Badge; status-palette checks every status tone, in both appearances, both themes, on the page and on a card, at both sizes, paints its expected palette colours; error-tone is the red tone's per-tone story, named so because an export called Error would shadow the global); select: multiple-select-all-label-click, -virtual-click and -drag-after-clicks drive the select-all demo with real input (a click on the visible label, a pointer-free click on the row then Space, a held mouse drag from the trigger released on the row after two direct clicks); responsive-label-click-phone / -desktop click the responsive demo's visible label with real input and expect the Drawer or the Select to open; responsive-first-paint server-renders the select-responsive demo and hydrates it at 1280px, checking for no hydration warning and an unchanged trigger box; alert-dialog and drawer: overlay measures the overlayClassName overlay's computed tint and display in Chromium, and the docs show the prop once, on the Modal page; shared-pointer: hand-off-press-first and -second each check their first trusted move has no button down and then leave a press held, so whichever runs second checks that the Vitest set-up let go of it; corner-control-at-rest checks that a control in the viewport's corner is not hovered when its play starts; the held-press-* stories drive the press record in .storybook/held-press.ts with a fake driver, no real input; they test the test set-up, not a component).
_common_patterns.regressionFixture: story exists to host a play() regression test for a fixed bug (tag remove-layout / remove-layout-classes / remove-pointer and tag-group removable-keyboard / removable-stretched: the remove prop renders the X beside the toggle and must match the old child form's layout, keys and pointer behaviour; tag with-remove-as-child pins that the old child form still nests; date-input callback-ref: forwarded callback ref must still reach the picker button; checkbox and radio-group disabled-dimming: a disabled Base UI span must dim outside a Field; label disabled-peer-scope: in a flat layout a disabled control never dims an enabled control's label; code-block wrap-long-token: under wrap an unbreakable token wraps, a numbered wrapped line starts beside its number, and the unwrapped block still scrolls with its highlight to the end; code-block wrap-whitespace-lines: a numbered wrapped line of only spaces or a tab keeps its white space in a selection; toggle-group press-feedback, press-feedback-joined-* and press-feedback-spaced-standalone: a held item in a joined group keeps its size and place and shows the hover fill, while spaced items and a standalone Toggle keep the press scale; toggle-group press-feedback-consumer: a consumer's own active: fill on a joined item, held with and without hover; toggle-group press-matrix-*: per variant and theme, a held joined item's fill against a consumer's own active:, dark:active: and hover: classes, off and on, with and without hover; admin-sidebar phone-drawer-width-left / -right: admin-01's phone drawer measures 18rem at phone widths on both sides, not the Drawer's 75% / 24rem; combobox control-names: the clear, chevron and chip remove buttons' default names give way to a consumer's own visible text, native label, title or ARIA name and stay true while the list is open; button loading-names: a loading button keeps its label's name, is aria-busy, and keeps its size and spinner centre at default and sm, with and without an icon; button outline-foreground: an outline Button paints the foreground colour inside a muted parent, light and dark, while a consumer's colour class and the disabled colour still win). Not a docs variant; story-only by design.
_common_patterns.cssUtilityFixture: CSS-only utilities in base.css (scroll-fade, shimmer) have no component and no demo directory; their story hosts the browser play() test, and the docs page is theming/utilities.
_common_patterns.browserContractFixture: file-upload stories host play() tests that need a real browser: constructed DataTransfer drops and pastes, a real FileList in FormData, form reset timing, the unsupported form-bridge path, the page drop guard, row layout and focus. They test contracts, not docs variants, so they have no demo.
_common_patterns.spacedStoryTitle: date-picker: the story title Components/Date Picker kebabs to "date picker" (spaces are kept), so its stories never pair with demos/date-picker and both sides are allowlisted. The demos port the stories Default, Range, DateOfBirth, WithInput and WithTime; quick-picks takes the preset approach of date-input/natural-language (no chrono-node in the docs app) and form is the Basic story with a FieldError.
_common_patterns.worstCaseFixture: story feeds realistic worst-case data (80-char unbroken email, four-digit page, counts of 0 and 1) and its play() measures real layout in the browser — overflow, rects inside container and viewport, positioner z-index. A layout regression test, not a docs variant; story-only by design.
_common_patterns.originFixture: Six browser stories measure each popup's computed origin against its trigger in upper, lower and RTL fixtures. They have no corresponding docs demo.
